NSA Ajit Doval to receive Lokmanya Tilak National Award

National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is set to receive the Lokmanya Tilak National Award on August 1. The award recognizes his contributions to national security. The ceremony will take place on the anniversary of Lokmanya Tilak's death.
